skill.name: video-enhancement
skill.description: Upscale, denoise, and sharpen short videos through Verging AI. The skill supports local files, YouTube or Bilibili URLs, optional trimming, HD mode, and result download.
skill.summary: Enhance short videos with Verging AI upscaling, denoising, trimming, and optional HD output.
skill.author: verging.ai

security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally uses external network calls, local media commands, temporary files, and a Verging API key. Many Markdown backtick detections are formatting false positives, but the documented execution flow confirms real curl, yt-dlp, ffprobe, and ffmpeg use. No prompt injection attempt was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Use the environment variable only, avoid API key command flags, redact Authorization headers from logs, and document key rotation steps.
Ask for explicit consent before uploading videos, and document retention, public URL behavior, and sensitive media restrictions.
Validate URLs and file paths, restrict protocols, quote arguments safely, and avoid shell interpolation when invoking media tools.
Create per-run temporary directories with restrictive permissions, random names, and cleanup that also runs after failures.

content.user_title: Enhance Short Videos with AI Upscaling
content.value_statement: Short videos can lose detail after compression, trimming, or remote downloads. This skill uses Verging AI workflows to upscale, denoise, and return enhanced clips.
actual_capabilities: Accepts local video files and YouTube or Bilibili URLs as input.
Trims videos with start and end time options before enhancement.
Supports normal and HD enhancement modes with credit estimates.
Uploads media through the Verging API and creates enhancement jobs.
Polls job progress and returns the final result URL.
Can download the completed enhanced video to a chosen output path.
limitations: Requires a Verging API key and enough paid or granted credits.
Depends on local yt-dlp, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and curl commands.
Uploads video content to external Verging and storage services.
Processes only a 30 second segment, so longer videos are trimmed.

use_cases.title: Improve Creator Clips
use_cases.description: Upscale a short social clip, reduce noise, and download a cleaner version for publishing.

use_cases.title: Prepare Marketing Shorts
use_cases.description: Trim a campaign video to the required segment and create an HD version for review.

use_cases.title: Restore Review Footage
use_cases.description: Enhance a rights-cleared archived clip before editing, sharing, or quality inspection.

prompt_templates.title: Enhance a Local Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance my local video at ./clip.mp4 with default quality. Show the credit estimate before starting the job.

prompt_templates.title: Trim a Remote Clip
prompt_templates.prompt: Enhance this YouTube clip from 5 to 25 seconds. Use normal quality and return the final result link.

prompt_templates.title: Create an HD Review File
prompt_templates.prompt: Use my Verging API key from the environment. Enhance ./promo.mp4 in HD from 3 to 28 seconds and save the result in ./exports.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Controlled Enhancement
prompt_templates.prompt: Before uploading, confirm the clip duration, credit cost, output path, and that the media is approved for external processing.

output_examples.input: Local 18 second MP4 in normal mode.
output: The skill reports the estimated credit cost.
It uploads the trimmed clip and starts the enhancement job.
It returns a completion status and final video link.

output_examples.input: Remote YouTube clip with HD mode and a 20 second trim.
output_examples.output: The skill downloads the requested segment, enhances it in HD, and saves the finished video when download is enabled.

output_examples.input: Rights-cleared archive clip with noise and low resolution.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a sharper enhanced clip and reports where the processed result can be accessed.

best_practices: Use only videos you own or have permission to process externally.
Keep the Verging API key in an environment variable and rotate it after exposure.
Set start and end times to control cost and stay within the 30 second limit.
anti_patterns: Do not paste real API keys into prompts, command examples, screenshots, or logs.
Do not upload private, regulated, or client media without explicit approval.
Do not pass unknown remote URLs without checking source trust and rights.

faq.question: Does the enhancement run only on my computer?
faq.answer: No. Local tools prepare the clip, then the video is uploaded to Verging for enhancement.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: The skill requires a Verging API key, usually provided through the VERGING_API_KEY environment variable.

faq.question: Can it process YouTube or Bilibili videos?
faq.answer: Yes, if yt-dlp is installed and you have the rights to download and process the video.

faq.question: What is the maximum video length?
faq.answer: The documented maximum is 30 seconds. Longer videos should be trimmed before enhancement.

faq.question: What tools must be installed locally?
faq.answer: The workflow expects yt-dlp, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and curl to be available.

faq.question: Can it download the final result automatically?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented download option saves the completed enhanced video to the chosen output path.
